variants.notes: Official AR service with V2 model runner and resident ServicePipelinePool. P controls page_max_inflight; one pipeline and preprocessor, official generation and HTTP defaults.

Official PyPI 4.0.11 runtime, Standard/Torch/local vLLM V1 API; release checkout is reference only. P controls document clients and --concurrency. Official preload, window/batches, VLM concurrency and compilation defaults. Full document rendering preserves cross-page joins. Experiment history and verification scope are recorded only in PROJECT_STATE.md; no optimal throughput claim.

Official model-bundled helpers, strict benchmark prompt, FastMTP eagle K=3. Resident AsyncLLM global page pool; worker extension only calls official register in spawned engines. Reuses unchanged DFlash environment and CUDA 12.8 JIT toolkit. GPU3 sync/P1/P2/latency smoke passed, no joint. Known pip check missing torchcodec; no package changes. No formal throughput search.

Official batch whole-page prompt, RGB/2048px encoding and Markdown postprocessing; no region or joint route. One resident vLLM service, global page pool; P bounds page render/request tasks across PDFs. Latency serializes PDFs and page requests. Reuses gdb_glmocr without dependency changes. Project PDF rendering is 200 DPI and service context is 32768; official batch generation is 16384 tokens, temperature 0, top_p 0.8, thinking disabled, request timeout 600 seconds. Empty/length responses follow project execution-success policy; real errors propagate. GPU 6 startup, P1/P2 and sequential latency smoke passed on two PDFs/four pages; no final throughput tuning claim.

Official vllm-async-engine with its model plugin and logits processor; no source patch. One resident runtime; P bounds shared layout/region requests within a PDF, documents remain sequential. Fixed-P, sweep and latency entrypoints registered; unified adapter GPU smoke and teardown verification still required. No joint/page_pool variant or cross-document feed.

Official vLLM single-page route. The model card limits each prompt to one image; P is global in-flight page requests across PDFs. No whole-document joint profile is registered. Official serving settings are limit-mm-per-prompt image=1, processor cache 0 and prefix caching disabled; generation uses max_tokens=4096, temperature=0.2 and top_p=0.9. The current adapter reuses gdb_glmocr until a real vLLM model-start smoke proves that its locked vLLM version supports this architecture.

Official WeVisDoc vLLM single-page route. P bounds the global in-flight page pool across PDFs; outputs are ordered page-wise and are not whole-document joint inference. Reuses gdb_glmocr without installing requirements-local.txt or adding packages.

Document-only composition based on mineru_344_2605. Shared official MinerU /tasks + Popo vLLM, P CPU clients, ready/start/done timing; single-GPU, pressure and full-workflow entries connected. Popo HEAD plus same_page/PR12/PR15/failure_propagation patches, not pristine upstream. Services reuse unchanged gdb_mineru (vLLM0.11.2/Torch2.9.0+cu128/Transformers4.57.6); CPU clients use gdb_mineru_popo. GPU4: two documents/five pages passed with MinerU0.20/Popo0.68, context16384, BF16 and unchanged sampling. Fixed20/146-page P1/P2/P4 trials processed all inputs but failed acceptance: 16/16/17 successful documents, 105/105/112 successful pages. Shared failures: upstream tree omits unanchored table-only blocks, and two Popo prompts exceed context16384. P1/P2 additionally hit MinerU UniMERNet MFR OOM; not observed in P4, not proven fixed. No stable/best profile saved. Explicit service interpreter/context/memory required; standalone MinerU default0.55 unchanged. Official contd/image empty relation strings accepted only on normal stop; null/truncation/other-task empty responses fail. Old cold/TF code remains recoverable at c533601.

The checkpoint lives under v1.0/ in the same official model repository used by 1.5. Runtime inference uses the current compatibility checkout and model-bundled remote code; ce4a967 is retained only as the historical source revision.
The active profile is ordinary AR inference. DFlash is exposed through the separate hunyuanocr_15_dflash execution variant.

Lossless speculative-decoding execution variant of HunyuanOCR-1.5. It shares the AR page adapter and output normalization, but uses the independently pinned vLLM dev869 DFlash service environment. RTX 3090 smoke uses a hardware-adapted 65536 context instead of the official 131072 context.

Inference uses model-bundled remote code; the locked Qianfan-VL checkout is reference-only. The active route follows the model-card basic prompt on one image per request, with a shared bounded page pool and ordered per-PDF export. vLLM uses max_tokens=16384, temperature=0 and max_model_len=32768.

Layout-as-Thought shares the checkpoint, environment and page-pool implementation with ordinary Qianfan. It follows the model-card prompt with a literal <think> suffix, retains raw replies and removes the leading thinking block before Markdown export.

Only deepseek_ocr2_page_pool is runnable: one resident client, spawn CPU preprocessing and one AsyncLLM service. P1/P2 each completed 20 documents/146 pages on different RTX 3090 GPUs; P4 port-conflict failure is not valid capacity evidence. CPU-only cleanup regression does not replace a new GPU smoke. Known Chinese transcription/format omissions remain; tracked bytecode artifacts are not source changes.

Shared official PDF pipeline with pipeline_version v1.5 and its own checkpoint. Current 200 DPI/4096 generation/16384 context, single-pipeline queue route passed a bounded document check; pressure curve and full benchmark are not verified. See docs/RUN_COMMANDS.md and docs/THROUGHPUT_TUNING_PROTOCOL.md.

Shared official PDF pipeline with pipeline_version v1.6 and its own checkpoint. Current single-pipeline queue route passed 4-document/9-page smoke and bounded P=1/2/4/8 runs. Shared repeated-paragraph content issue is unresolved; no full-dataset optimum or final pressure selected. See THROUGHPUT_TUNING_PROTOCOL.md.
The benchmark runs the official two-stage GLM-OCR plus PP-DocLayoutV3 pipeline.

Historical checkpoint; shared compatibility source, not exact A800 runner c10b932. Async-only single runtime with persistent loop. GPU2 bounded smoke and GPU7 20 PDFs/146 pages at P=1/2/4 passed execution/output checks; content errors and cross-P differences remain. P4 fastest tested, not a selected formal profile or global optimum. Cleanup verified CPU/dry-run only; see smoke and throughput docs.
